column1: # #1023 A/B shared oracle for a collection that starts after children that consumed nothing, measured with Java
# (NamedCapture / SemanticPredicateParser / CaptureBoundaryParser.input), columns and entries as full.tsv.
# A Java collector returns a token of the consumed kind even when it is empty: Chain, NonOrdered, Choice, LongestChoice,
# Optional / ZeroOrMore (Opt / Rep), a rule (LazyChain), SyncPointRecoveryParser (Rec), CaptureBoundaryParser.value /
# .input (Val / VB / IB; Rust TextValue / ValueBoundary / InputCaptureBoundary) and EmptyParser (E; Rust JavaEmpty).
# Such an empty token starts the collection of its parent at its position, so a later child of another kind (vci, vc)
# leaves "" there, not at the consumed cursor. A PEG assertion (&c, !z = PegLookahead(z, false)) returns no token, and
# NamedCapture (Own), Commit (Cmt), Label (Lbl) and InvertMatchPropagationStopper (SI; Rust stop_invert) return what
# their child returned. Rule[Chain[MO,c]]: a rule collects the plain input of its body too. Other shapes as full.tsv.
